Game Overview

At its heart, Winter Battle is a two-player game about embrace the winter chaos as Santa and the Grinch face off in a frantic gift-grabbing duel. Accumulate presents to grow in size, beware of dangerous decoys, and race against time to claim victory. The snowy battlefield awaits your swift reflexes and strategic prowess.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Winter Battle is easy to pick up. Embrace the winter chaos as Santa and the Grinch face off in a frantic gift-grabbing duel.
